set system host-name CE2.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set ethernet-switching-options cfm versi.explanation: Configure the version of the CFM that is used as a criterion for exchange options.

set ethernet-switching-options cfm.explanation: 启用以太网交换选项的CFM功能。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: This command fragment configures a Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) maintenance domain in Junos, defining a specific domain for Ethernet OAM fault detection and monitoring.

parameters.name: maintenance-domain
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the domain.

level 6.explanation: Configure the level of the CFM maintenance field.

maintenance-association ma2.explanation: This command configures CFM (Connectivity Fault Management) by defining a maintenance domain (`parameter1`) and a maintenance association (`parameter2`) for Ethernet switching.

parameters.name: maintenance-association
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the association.

vlan-id 10.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs in CFM maintenance.

mep 62.explanation: This command configures a Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) Maintenance End Point (MEP) within a specified maintenance domain and association for Ethernet switching, enabling fault detection and monitoring.

parameters.name: mep
parameters.explanation: Maintains the ID of the endpoint (MEP).

interface ge-1/0/1.explanation: Configures a Maintenance End Point (MEP) on a specific interface within a CFM maintenance domain and association for Ethernet OAM fault detection and performance monitoring.

direction down.explanation: Configure CFM maintenance domains to maintain associated MEP interfaces and their direction.

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] continuity-check-interval [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md2 maintenance-association ma2 mep 62 continuity-check-interval 10s
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 配置CFM维护域和维护关联的MEP的连续性检查间隔。

parameters.name: continuity-check-interval
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查的时间间隔，例如10s。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] continuity-check [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md2 maintenance-association ma2 mep 62 continuity-check enable
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 启用CFM维护域和维护关联的MEP的连续性检查。

parameters.name: continuity-check
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查的状态，例如enable。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md2 maintenance-association ma2 remote-mep 61
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 配置CFM维护域和维护关联的远程MEP。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] continuity-check-receive [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md2 maintenance-association ma2 remote-mep 61 continuity-check-receive enable
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 启用CFM维护域和维护关联的远程MEP的连续性检查接收。

parameters.name: continuity-check-receive
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查接收的状态，例如enable。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ais [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md2 maintenance-association ma2 mep 62 ais enable
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 启用CFM维护域和维护关联的MEP的AIS功能。

set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.template: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] maintenance-association [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ais [parameter4]
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.command: set ethernet-switching-options cfm maintenance-domain md2 maintenance-association ma2 mep 62 ais suppress-alarm
set ethernet-switching-options cfm maint.explanation: 配置CFM维护域和维护关联的MEP的AIS功能以抑制警报。

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family ethernet-switching port-mode trun.explanation: Configure the interface 's port mode is trunk.

family ethernet-switching vlan members 1.explanation: Configure the VLAN members of the interface.
